title: 第17章 看她装糖阴他一手第18章 你蠢吗当然是因为我叛变了
slug: 穿成女配弹幕让我又争又抢
content_zh:
袁松亭顺着季月的视线看过去，同样什么都没看见。
“季师姐，我们现在是同一条线上的蚂蚱，都别说出去好吗？”
宗门规矩不能随意残杀人类，邪修例外，违反者修为尽毁逐出宗门，他好不容易进的天山宗，村里人都以他为荣，他还有大好前途，不能毁在此处。
“你有病？谁杀了人，到处出去嚷嚷，我还是你同伙，行了，你赶紧走吧。”
季月没好气的怼袁松亭，抄起一个扫帚往恭房走去。
袁松亭得了准话，悬着的心才算落了地，捏爆低阶隐身符，悄无声息没了踪影。
季月走进恭房，里面干干净净，那股臭味也消失了。
她脑中浮现出一种名叫咕咕兽的大型鸟类，长得很像猫头鹰，专门吃腐食，大概是它们路过，她便没放在心上。
入夜，厚重的乌云像浸墨的棉絮，严严实实的盖住月亮，后山的参天古木间，大风打着旋儿乱窜发出呜咽声。
季月关上所有房间的窗户，才躺到床上睡觉。
她睡着没一会儿，屋中温度骤降，她迷迷糊糊的用手捞了捞被子，将自己裹成一个球，可是寒意不减，反而越来越深。
窗外一声惊雷炸响，惨白的闪电劈开云层，瞬间照亮整个屋子，季月也就是这时睁开惺忪的眼睛。
下一秒，她的心脏咚的一下跳到嗓子眼！
床沿边，赫然站着个浑身漆黑的鬼！青面獠牙狰狞可怖，一双猩红的眼睛死死地盯着她。
“啊——！”
季月惊恐尖叫一声，连滚带爬的往床里缩，后背撞在坚硬的墙面，才算是找回几分理智，一股怒火腾地窜上来，她指着恶鬼吼道：
“你他妈是人是鬼？大半夜的装神弄鬼！”
鬼煞从鼻子里发出冷哼，声音像生锈的铁片在摩擦：“你只需知道，有人要我来杀你。”
昏暗中的季月眉头蹙起，“你别说话了，晦涩喑哑难如听。”
“…”鬼煞沉默。

他握着短刀的手猛地扬起，寒光直逼季月面门，季月下意识的往旁边滚，刀刃落空扎进锦被中，带出来的棉花在空中飘。
【宿主是否呼唤师尊祝徵求助？】
【宿主是否呼唤师兄谢长歌求助？】
【宿主是否向自己求助？】
三条突兀的电子机械音响彻在季月脑海中，是系统！
她脱口而出：“呼唤祝徵求助！”
毕竟大晚上打扰谢长歌睡觉挺不好意思的，祝徵不一样，他都活了几百年，老年人应该没有觉睡。
至于第三她压根不用考虑，她一个废人，能求助自己什么？求敌人早点她上路吗？
系统：【选择无效，请宿主继续选择。】
鬼煞挥着第二刀朝娇小的身影砍去，季月又一个翻滚，裙摆却拖了后腿，鬼煞眼疾手快，一把攥住她裙摆。
季月一边拼命用腿踹向鬼煞，一边对系统大喊：“呼唤师兄谢长歌！！！”
系统：【选择无效，请宿主继续选择。】
content_en:
Yuan Songting followed Ji Yue's line of sight and saw nothing.
"Senior Sister Ji, we are grasshoppers on the same line now, so don't even tell us, okay?"
The rules of the sect cannot kill human beings at will, except for evil cultivators. Those who violate it will have their cultivation level destroyed and expelled from the sect. He finally entered the Tianshan Sect, and everyone in the village is proud of him. He still has a great future and cannot be ruined here.
"Are you sick? Whoever kills someone and goes out to make noise, I am still your accomplice. Okay, you can leave quickly."
Ji Yue angrily scolded Yuan Songting, picked up a broom and walked to the palace.
After Yuan Songting got the right words, his hanging heart finally fell to the ground. He exploded the low-level invisibility charm and disappeared silently.
Ji Yue walked into Gong's room. It was clean and the smell had disappeared.
She thought of a large bird called a coogo, which looked like an owl and specialized in eating carrion. She probably didn't pay attention to them because they passed by.
At night, thick dark clouds were like ink-soaked cotton wool, covering the moon tightly. Among the towering ancient trees in the back mountain, the strong wind whirled and whimpered.
Ji Yue closed all the windows in the room before lying on the bed and sleeping.
Not long after she fell asleep, the temperature in the room dropped sharply. She drowsily picked up the quilt with her hands and wrapped herself into a ball. However, the chill did not diminish, but became deeper and deeper.
There was a thunder outside the window, and pale lightning split the clouds, illuminating the entire room instantly. It was then that Ji Yue opened her sleepy eyes.
The next second, her heart jumped into her throat!
Standing beside the bed was a ghost covered in pitch black! The green face had ferocious fangs, and a pair of scarlet eyes stared at her.
"Ah——!"
Ji Yue screamed in horror, rolled and crawled into the bed, and hit her back against the hard wall. Only then did she regain some sense, and a surge of anger rushed up. She pointed at the evil ghost and shouted:
"Are you a fucking human or a ghost? You are pretending to be a ghost in the middle of the night!"
Gui Sha snorted coldly from his nose, his voice sounding like rusty iron scraping together: "You just need to know that someone wants me to kill you."
Ji Yue frowned in the darkness, "Stop talking. It's so obscure and mute that it's hard to hear."
"..." Gui Sha was silent.
He suddenly raised the hand holding the short knife, and the cold light hit Ji Yue's face. Ji Yue subconsciously rolled to the side, and the blade fell into the brocade quilt, and the cotton brought out floated in the air.
[Does the host call Master Zhu Zheng for help? 】
[Is the host calling senior brother Xie Changge for help? 】
[Does the host seek help from itself? 】
Three sudden electronic mechanical sounds echoed in Ji Yue's mind, it was the system!
She blurted out: "Call Zhu Zheng for help!"
After all, it's embarrassing to disturb Xie Changge's sleep at night. Zhu Zheng is different. He has lived for hundreds of years, so the elderly should not be able to sleep.
As for the third one, she didn't have to think about it at all. She was a useless person, what could she ask for help? Begging the enemy to get her on the road as soon as possible?
System: [Selection is invalid, host please continue to select. 】
Gui Sha swung his second knife and slashed at the petite figure. Ji Yue rolled again, but the hem of her skirt was holding her back. Gui Sha had quick eyes and quick hands and grabbed the hem of her skirt.
While Ji Yue kicked Gui Sha with all her strength, she shouted to the system: "Call Senior Brother Xie Changge!!!"
